items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I knew this fighter, Art Woods

ctx.x: Who was your band at Minton’s?
I don’t know who I had then. I’m sorry. I can’t remember the musicians. But what happened, I knew this fighter, Art Woods...
Oh, he used to work at Dayton’s Records on 12th and Broadway.
